Name: Kat's Expanded Farm
Author: ilikecookiecats
Description:
This is basically and edited/updated version of Bawbag's Farm Extension Mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3096), which in turn was based off Gnarly's Farm Expansion Mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1187). Then stretched to be the same size as lillvik's A Bigger Standard Map (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2443).

This is my first mod--the result of a desire to have a big stylish farm and a night of studying the Modding Section of the Stardew Valley. It's nothing grand since it was mostly editing work.

To install: After downloading, just extract it into your Mods folder.

Note: In an uncertain point in time, I might consider adding a water feature...if anyone has tips on how to do that.

[b][color=#ffd966][size=4]Note 2: I've received posts about whether this mod can be made compatible with MTN or has any with SVE.  I'm gonna tell you I'm not a programmer. I just went off of what the Modding Wiki can tell me, or at least the parts I can understand.  If there is anyone willing to make compatibilities with this mod, feel free to do so.[/size][/color][/b]

Manifest.Name: Kat's Expanded Farm
Manifest.Description: Expanded Standard Farm with tillable grass field.
